scope: Deepen and broaden the existing UCS orthographic-option plan against the primary DXF reference, current group-code typing, open-source reader/writer boundaries, and local parser/writer readiness.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus local source/test/plan inspection
localInspection: src/drw_objects.h: DRW_UCS scalar orthoType, orthographicOptions, compatibility orthoOrigin, and baseUcsHandle
src/drw_objects.cpp: DRW_UCS::parseCode, validatePayloadFields, validateDxf, and parseDwg/encodeDwg boundaries
src/libdxfrw.cpp: dxfRW::processUCS pending tuple parse/publication and dxfRW::writeUCS group emission
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: generated testUcsOrthographicOptions cases in the shared worktree
method.evidenceRule: Autodesk DXF field descriptions inform DXF semantics but the internally inconsistent group-79/346 note is not resolved by assumption. ObjectARX group-code typing establishes storage width only. Mutable peer source/docs are scoped evidence, not producer qualification. ODA remains authoritative for any DWG byte-layout change.

evidence.topic: Autodesk UCS tuple roles and group-79 inconsistency
evidence.observed: The 2024 UCS DXF reference assigns orthographic types 1 through 6 to repeated group-71 selectors paired with group-13/23/33 origin coordinates. It describes group 79 as always zero, while its group-346 note also refers to group 79 being zero/nonzero. No producer example resolving this contradiction was found in the reviewed source set.
evidence.localObservation: The UCS parser/writer shares orthoType across DWG and DXF. The active DXF parser edits now route group 71 into pending tuple state, but finalization still allows incomplete coordinate masks and type values outside 1 through 6. The writer still emits shared orthoType as group 79 and emits base-UCS group 346 when a base handle is present.
evidence.disposition: Do not map group 71 to group 79, do not infer selectors from orthoOrigin, and do not silently normalize nonzero group-79/base-UCS state. Keep nonzero 79 and UCS-record 346 unresolved until a producer-authored literal record and native save/reopen evidence resolve them. Require complete finite XYZ tuples and documented selector values 1 through 6 for the supported DXF option path.

evidence.observed: ObjectARX classifies codes 68 through 79 as 16-bit integers but does not define UCS-specific semantics. QGIS current source emits a group-79 zero baseline without repeated option tuples. ezdxf documentation states UCS table entries do not participate in ezdxf's coordinate transformations. GDAL documents an OGR projection route, not UCS table semantic application.
evidence.localObservation: The inspected peer sources do not provide a positive independent semantic witness for repeated UCS orthographic options or the UCS-record 346 relationship.
evidence.disposition: Use ObjectARX only for width constraints and QGIS only as a zero-baseline wire comparator when pinned. Exclude ezdxf/GDAL agreement from UCS semantic qualification; no peer dependency or external-J promotion is justified.

evidence.observed: The existing 7BG owner already contains generated ASCII/binary round-trip and atomic refusal scaffolding, but its planned partial-coordinate zero-default expectation is not supported by the Autodesk wording that the 71 selector is paired with the 13/23/33 point tuple.
evidence.localObservation: The current partial-tuple test treats missing Y/Z as valid zeros; tuple finalization has no complete-mask assertion. Existing focused target infrastructure can run this slice without registering or executing a full suite.
evidence.disposition: Change the focused negative case to reject each missing coordinate and add selector-range checks; use the existing fixture test target and a focused selector, then defer the local-roundtrip suite to the shared integration checkpoint. No external fixture or new CTest is needed.
